Three.js 0.180.0

These browser ES modules are copied unchanged from the `three@0.180.0` npm package:

- `build/three.module.min.js`
- `build/three.core.min.js`

Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180

The MIT license is included in `LICENSE`. Keeping the modules here lets the robot game run without a CDN or a build step.
